title: Lazar given part disinformation in a controlled leak

tellings.quote: So, what he might have been provided was part information and part disinformation and a controlled leak happened,

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who said in the late 1980s that he had worked on alien craft at Area 51, the secret Air Force test site in Nevada, may have been fed a mix of truth and falsehood on purpose. That is the view of a researcher named Steven Greer, who tells Michels that Lazar "might have been provided" with "part information and part disinformation" in "a controlled leak." If so, some of Lazar's story would be real and some planted to confuse anyone who looked into it.
